recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this issue; any future targetDisease cardinality work belongs in the Immunization Incubator source if that artifact changes.
issue_request: FHIR-14371 was a Published/Persuasive Public Health change request for STU3 asking to change ImmunizationEvaluation.targetDisease from 1..* to 1..1 so each evaluation addresses a single target disease.
initial_application: Commit 4ed3a43a167d84b12c47c5fa50f81bb146e39e6e changed the ImmunizationEvaluation spreadsheet targetDisease row from 1..* to 1..1 and added the #14371 committee note. The generated/source StructureDefinition later carried max="1" and the #14371 note until ImmunizationEvaluation was removed from core.
additional_context: PHWG 2018-06-14 minutes align with the Jira vote and place FHIR-14371 in the immunization ticket block. Current core no longer has an active ImmunizationEvaluation source folder or fhir.ini resource entry; commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 removed the resource and current core pages link to the external Immunization Incubator StructureDefinition. The external current JSON reports ImmunizationEvaluation.targetDisease min 1 and max 1.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR core source edit is needed because the historical application matched the Jira resolution and current core no longer owns the active StructureDefinition.

related_jiras.note: Discussed in the same PHWG minutes and applied in the same 2018 source commit, but it concerns Immunization.protocolApplied rather than ImmunizationEvaluation.targetDisease cardinality.
